exposure: Carriers of the heterozygotic variant of the IRS1 gene
heterozygotic variant of the IRS 1 gene
outcome: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis in the first trimester
cohort: 140 women with singleton pregnancies delivering at term
finding: While not statistically significant, carriers of specific variants of T2DM candidate genes might be at increased risk of delivering macrosomic newborns.
